summary: Upgrading a 2.4 deployment of one controller VM, one hub VM and a managed PostgreSQL 15 database leads to the same 2.6 growth topology: platform gateway with Redis, controller, private automation hub, EDA controller, an execution node and managed PostgreSQL 15.
questions: What VMs do I need to upgrade AAP 2.4 controller and hub to 2.6 growth?
